system.description:
Hunting is used to capture or kill prey animals in the wild so that they might be consumed as food.

Obstacles: Hunting domestic animals, Ob 1. Hunting feral animals, Ob 2. Hunting wild animals or goblins, Ob 3. Hunting Trolls, Ob 4. Hunting Great Spiders, Ob 5. Hunting Great Wolves, Ob 6. Hunting monsters, Ob 7.

FoRKs: Tracking, Trapper

Skill Type: Forester. Tools: Yes: bow or javelin.

Root: Per/Agi

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 277
